fields.label: 2-Minute Simple Biography
fields.value: Jean Rhys was a novelist born in Dominica who lived mostly in England. Her birth name was Ella Rees Williams. She was born in 1890 and died in Exeter in 1979. She is famous for Wide Sargasso Sea, a prequel (an earlier story) to Jane Eyre.

fields.label: Why Important for UGC NET
fields.value: UGC NET asks Rhys under Unit III (Fiction). The usual match is Wide Sargasso Sea with 1966 and Jane Eyre. Good Morning, Midnight is the 1939 novel, not the 1966 one. Questions also test Antoinette Cosway as the woman Bronte called Bertha Mason.

fields.value: Nirad C. Chaudhuri was an Indian writer of English non-fiction. He was born in Kishoreganj, in East Bengal, in 1897, and he died in Oxford in 1999. He praised British rule and attacked much of modern Indian life. His 1951 autobiography made him famous and made him enemies.

fields.value: Samuel Beckett was an Irish playwright, novelist, and poet. He was born in Dublin in 1906 and died in Paris in 1989. After 1945 he wrote many of his major works in French. He won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1969.
